gloss: to overflow; to be filled with; to brim with

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {溢|あふ}れていませんでした

definitions.explanation: For liquid or contents to exceed a container's capacity and spill out.

definitions.gloss: to be filled with; to brim with
definitions.explanation: To be full of an emotion, quality, or abundance of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{溢|あふ}れた。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溢|あふ}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{溢|あふ}れ⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: The water is about to overflow from the glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{溢|あふ}れて⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溢|あふ}れた⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked through a market brimming with energy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{溢|あふ}れて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The town was overflowing with tourists.

notes:
{溢|あふ}れる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) describing overflow or abundance.

ASPECT (ている):
{溢|あふ}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates something is currently overflowing or full of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [container]⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧[liquid]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{溢|あふ}れる — [liquid] overflows from [container]
- [quality]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溢|あふ}れる — to be full of [quality]
- [place]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧[things]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{溢|あふ}れる — [place] is overflowing with [things]
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{溢|あふ}れる (tears overflow)
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溢|あふ}れる (full of affection)
- ⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溢|あふ}れる (full of vitality)
- ⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溢|あふ}れる (full of smiles)

OFTEN WRITTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This verb is frequently written as あふれる rather than {溢|あふ}れる due to the kanji's complexity.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{零|こぼ}れる→こぼれる：02105_koboreru⟧: to spill (smaller amounts, drops)
- {溢|あふ}れる: to overflow (larger amounts, abundance)
